fingerprint.description: Uniquely identifies this particular WeChat Pay account. You can use this attribute to check whether two WeChat accounts are the same.

location.description: ID of the [location](https://docs.stripe.com/api/terminal/locations) that this transaction's reader is assigned to.

reader.description: ID of the [reader](https://docs.stripe.com/api/terminal/readers) this transaction was made on.

transaction_id.description: Transaction ID of this particular WeChat Pay transaction.
